# Verdetto

> Verdetto is a free QR code and barcode scanner for Android with no ads and no fake buttons. It shows the link before it opens, is built to read damaged codes, and checks scanned content for warning signs on the phone. It never says anything is safe: "No warnings found" means none of its checks matched.

Publisher: Verdetto, Virginia, United States. Contact: support@verdettoqr.com. Store title: "Verdetto: QR & Barcode Scanner". Status: coming soon to Google Play. Verdetto and the Verdetto QR mark are trademarks; a United States application for VERDETTO is pending (serial no. 50092495).

Official accounts: Mastodon https://mastodon.social/@VerdettoQR; Reddit https://www.reddit.com/user/VerdettoQR/; GitHub https://github.com/verdettoqr. Pronounced ver-DET-oh; Italian for verdict.

## Facts

- Platform: Android. Price: free. Ads: none. Accounts: none. Analytics: none.
- Scanning and every built-in check run on the phone; online lookups (list updates, shortened- and affiliate-link destinations, domain age, and product, book, medicine, music, journal, device, and vehicle details from Open Food Facts, Open Library, the German and French national libraries, openFDA, DailyMed and RxNav, Spain's medicines agency AEMPS, the European Commission's EUDAMED, the US Consumer Product Safety Commission's recalls, MusicBrainz, Crossref, Wikidata, the NHTSA vehicle, recall, and crash-test databases, and the EPA fuel-economy database) are on by default and can be turned off.
- Reads QR codes and barcodes including EAN, UPC, Code 128, Data Matrix, PDF417, and Aztec, and is built to read damaged ones.
- Scan history stays on the phone (and in the phone's own backup unless that is turned off); scans older than 90 days clear unless starred; any entry can be deleted.
- Permissions: the camera to scan; contacts only if the person fills their own card from the phone's profile.
- Funding: no ads, no data sales, no paid tier; paid for and passed on by the people who use it. An optional one-time in-app contribution, from $0.99 ($2.99 suggested) through Google Play, supports development; nothing is locked behind it. The app never nags; after it does something for you it may say thank you, at most once a month, and a switch turns that off. Verdetto is a small business; a contribution is a purchase, not a gift, and brings no tax benefit.
